back_translation: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD in the days of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, saying:
Go to the house of the Rechabites, speak to them, and bring them to the house of the LORD, to one of the chambers, and give them wine to drink.
So I took Jaazaniah son of Jeremiah, son of Habazziniah, and his brothers and all his sons—the whole house of the Rechabites—

and I brought them to the house of the LORD, to the chamber of the sons of Hanan son of Igdaliah, a man of God, which was beside the chamber of the officials, above the chamber of Maaseiah son of Shallum, keeper of the threshold.
Then I set before the men of the house of the Rechabites pitchers full of wine, and cups, and I said to them, Drink wine.
But they said, We do not drink wine, for Jonadab son of Rechab our forefather commanded us, saying, You shall not drink wine, neither you nor your descendants, forever.
And do not build a house, do not sow seed, do not plant a vineyard, and do not have these things; but live in tents all your days, so that you may live many days in the land where you sojourn.
And we have obeyed the voice of Jonadab son of Rechab our forefather in all that he commanded us, not to drink wine all our days—we, our wives, our sons, and our daughters—
and not to build houses to live in, and we have no vineyard, field, or seed.
But we have lived in tents, and have obeyed and done all that Jonadab our forefather commanded us.
But when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against the land, we said, Come, let us go into Jerusalem to escape the army of the Chaldeans and the army of Aram; so we have remained in Jerusalem.
Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah, saying:
This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: Go and tell the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, Will you not accept discipline and obey my words? declares the LORD.

The command of Jonadab son of Rechab has been carried out—he commanded his sons not to drink wine, and they have not drunk it to this day, because they obeyed the command of their forefather. But I have spoken to you again and again, and you have not obeyed me.

I sent to you all my servants the prophets, again and again, saying, Turn now each of you from his evil way and amend your deeds, and do not go after other gods to serve them; then you will live in the land that I gave to you and to your fathers. But you have not inclined your ear or obeyed me.
The sons of Jonadab son of Rechab have carried out the command of their forefather that he commanded them, but this people has not obeyed me.

Therefore this is what the LORD God of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: Behold, I am about to bring upon Judah and upon all the inhabitants of Jerusalem all the disaster that I pronounced against them, because I spoke to them but they did not hear, and I called to them but they did not answer.

And to the house of the Rechabites Jeremiah said: This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: Because you have obeyed the command of Jonadab your forefather and have kept all his commandments and have done all that he commanded you,
therefore this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: Jonadab son of Rechab will never lack a man to stand before me forever.
